checklist.name: post_hooks_skipped
checklist.description: Explains that Cobra does not run `PostRunE` (or `PersistentPostRunE`) when `RunE` returns an error.

checklist.name: defer_in_operation
checklist.description: Opens the database inside the operation called from `RunE` and closes it with `defer` in the same function.

checklist.name: error_returned
checklist.description: Still returns the import error from `RunE` rather than printing it or calling `os.Exit`.
